note: The nuclear data libraries behind the validation cases (QA-091): hash, source, version, licence and access conditions. None is stored in the repository; `record` is the committed provenance record and record_sha256 pins it.

libraries.name: FENDL-3.2 neutron data, OpenMC HDF5 build
libraries.sha256_of: cross_sections.xml index of the downloaded HDF5 directory
libraries.licence: IAEA NDS terms of use (terms not re-read for this build)
libraries.access_conditions: public download from the IAEA NDS; FARIS keeps the files local and Git-ignored

libraries.name: ENDF/B-VII.1 photoatomic and atomic relaxation sublibraries
libraries.licence: no explicit licence stated by the publisher; NNDC release notices state no restriction on distribution and ask for credit
libraries.access_conditions: public download from the NNDC. The NNDC download page states no explicit licence; redistribution rights are unresolved (docs/PHOTON_LIBRARY_ACQUISITION.md).

libraries.name: ENDF/B-VIII.1 neutron and thermal scattering data, OpenMC HDF5 build
libraries.source: National Nuclear Data Center via the OpenMC project, https://openmc.org/
libraries.sha256_of: cross_sections.xml index of the downloaded HDF5 directory
libraries.licence: no licence text checked for this build; treated like NNDC data (local research use)
libraries.access_conditions: public download through OpenMC; FARIS keeps the files local and Git-ignored

libraries.name: FARIS combined library v2 (FENDL-3.2 neutron, ENDF/B-VII.1 photon, thermal scattering)
libraries.source: assembled locally by scripts/build_nuclear_data_v2.py from the libraries above
libraries.licence: inherits the terms of its inputs; FENDL-3.2 and ENDF/B-VII.1 as above
libraries.access_conditions: built locally from public downloads; 'data/' is kept out of Git
